title: Per-pig feed plans: only stall and ESF pens?
detail: Per-pig feed plans only in stall and ESF pens; group-fed (trough/floor/trickle) pens adjust at pen level. The Feed plan PRD currently allows per-pig changes in trough pens. The Inspection walk no longer shows a feed tag on a pig row, on this basis. Status: open, owner to confirm.
options: Per-pig feed plans only where each pig is fed alone (stall, ESF); group-fed pens adjust at pen level
Keep per-pig changes in trough pens as the Feed plan PRD says
recommendation: Per-pig plans only in stall and ESF pens; trough, floor and trickle pens adjust at pen level, and the Feed plan PRD changes to match.
